name: Dublin

programs.title: Business, Economics, Social Science, Arts and Humanities
programs.summary: From this route, you can progress to degrees taught at the UCD Lochlann Quinn School of Business, which holds the rare ‘triple crown’ of accreditation — awarded to only the most influential business organisations.

programs.title: Engineering and Sciences
programs.summary: If you’re interested in studying a degree in STEM, this route will prepare you for your future at UCD, and the world of work.

description: With the unique combination of a friendly village feel and the buzz of a big city, Dublin is a great place to be a student. Ireland's capital ranks among the top 40 cities for students in the world (QS Best Student Cities 2022) and it often features as a top tourist destination.
